title: Glowing Bone Pile
description: A mound of ancient bones rises from the cracked flagstones, some still faintly glowing with necrotic energy that gutters like a dying candle. The air hums with residual magic, and thin wisps of spectral light drift upward from the pile. Whatever creature these belonged to, it was large — and it did not die willingly.

choices.label: Harvest the marrow
choices.description: Necrotic marrow is a prized component for dark crafting.

outcomes.text: You crack open the larger bones and scrape out thick, dark marrow that pulses faintly with residual energy. Good yield.
The marrow practically flows out — these bones are saturated with necrotic power. An exceptional find.
As you split the bones, a burst of necrotic flame scorches your hands. You salvage what you can through gritted teeth.

choices.label: Collect the spectral residue
choices.description: Threads of wraith-stuff cling to the bones like cobwebs.

outcomes.text: You wind the ghostly strands around a stick, careful not to let them touch your skin. They hum softly with trapped souls.
The threads are thicker here than usual — an entire cocoon of ectoplasm wraps the largest skull. A treasure trove of wraith material.
The threads lash out as you reach for them, searing spectral burns across your fingers. You manage to collect a few.

choices.label: Leave the dead be
choices.description: Disturbing the dead invites their attention.

outcomes.text: You step around the pile carefully. The spectral wisps watch you go, drifting lazily in your wake.
